title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Graph API options for icons, visibility, metadata and labels on custom connectors
notes: claim 67: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates the schema API as a way to set custom connector icons, rather than documenting the iconUrl label mapping it actually supports. The roadmap facts and the two controls as printed are supported, but the unchanged-permissions assurance also needs narrowing.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Scope
claims.claim: Developers build custom connectors with the Copilot connectors API to index their own external data for Microsoft 365 experiences.
claims.quote: You might want to build a custom connector to integrate with services that aren't available as connectors built by Microsoft. To build custom connectors, you use the Copilot connectors REST API.

claims.claim: A schema property has an optional description.
claims.quote: Optional but we recommend that you use this property for queryable properties.

claims.claim: The maximum supported property description length is 200 characters.
claims.quote: Optional but we recommend that you use this property for queryable properties. The maximum supported length is 200 characters.

claims.claim: Property descriptions help Copilot interpret queries and map them to properties.
claims.quote: This property enhances semantic understanding by helping Copilot interpret queries and accurately map them to properties that results in more relevant and precise responses.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: iconUrl is a semantic label for a schema property containing an icon URL.
claims.quote: | iconUrl | The URL of an icon. | thumbnailUrl, logo, previewImage |

claims.claim: Learn lists iconUrl, title and url as labels to apply so content surfaces in Copilot.
claims.quote: The `iconUrl`, `title`, and `url` labels must be applied for content to surface in Copilot.

claims.claim: The May 19, 2026 release note says developers can now configure the five kinds of custom connector options.
claims.quote: Developers can now configure icons, visibility settings, connection metadata, property descriptions, and semantic labels for custom connectors.

claims.claim: The schema guide still says property description support for custom connectors is expected in Q4 2025.
claims.quote: Support for adding property descriptions to custom connectors is expected in Q4 2025.

claims.claim: Learn does not identify precisely which API property the roadmap's visibility option refers to.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph externalConnection Copilot visibility isEnabled enabledContentExperiences connection metadata icon custom connectors; opened externalConnection v1.0/beta, beta Update connection, manage-connections and release notes; no explicit roadmap-to-property mapping.

claims.claim: Learn does not identify precisely which API property the roadmap's connection metadata option refers to.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph externalConnection Copilot visibility isEnabled enabledContentExperiences connection metadata icon custom connectors; opened externalConnection v1.0/beta and release notes. contentCategory is documented, but not explicitly identified as the roadmap option.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the arrival default for this set of new Graph API options.
claims.quote: Searched: custom Copilot connectors Graph API enhancements icons visibility metadata default enabled admin switch rollout; 502537 default. Read roadmap, May 19 release note, property and externalConnection v1.0/beta; no default for the new option set.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether an admin enablement switch applies to the arrival of these new Graph API options.
claims.quote: Searched: custom Copilot connectors Graph API enhancements icons visibility metadata default enabled admin switch rollout. Read roadmap, May 19 release note, manage-connector and experiences; general content-visibility controls exist, but no switch enabling this new API option set is stated.

claims.claim: Feature-specific rollout mechanics are not stated.

claims.claim: Rich connection descriptions improve the likelihood of content being displayed in Copilot.
claims.quote: Rich descriptions improve the likelihood of content displayed in Copilot.

claims.claim: Semantic labels help Copilot understand properties and improve relevance and ranking.
claims.quote: Schema recommendations analyze your connector schema and highlight missing semantic labels for key properties that Copilot relies on to understand, rank, and cite content.

claims.claim: Granting connector access to Everyone can lead to oversharing of sensitive content.
claims.quote: Incorrect access permission settings, such as granting access to Everyone, can lead to oversharing of sensitive content.

claims.claim: Deployed connectors are accessible tenant-wide unless external item security is locked down.
claims.quote: Any deployed Microsoft Graph connector is accessible tenant-wide unless the external items security is locked down.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/plugins/overview-copilot-connector to sources. Its 'Create your own synced Copilot connector' section states 'Deployed connectors are tenant-wide unless external item security is restricted.' The older overview URL supplied in the evidence list is not cited in the briefing and did not fetch, but its supporting passage was independently returned by Learn search.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: Learn gives no admin-center editing path for property labels and descriptions of the Graph API-built custom connectors defined in this briefing.
claims.quote: Searched: custom Copilot connector schema edit property labels description Microsoft 365 admin center SDK. Read manage-connector operations table and schema guide; SDK Assign property labels exists, but no admin editing path for Graph API-built custom schemas was documented.

claims.claim: A developer can set schema property descriptions through the Graph schema operation.
claims.quote: "description": "String"

claims.claim: A developer can assign semantic labels through the Graph schema operation.
claims.quote: You can assign semantic labels using the Graph API or from the Assign property labels page when using the SDK.

claims.claim: Icons for a custom connector are set through the Graph schema call in row 2.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph custom connector iconUrl schema label icon value externalItem properties. Read schema PATCH, property resource, schema guide, externalItem resource and SDK overview; these establish label mapping, not setting connector icons with schema PATCH.
claims.fix: Replace 'Property descriptions, labels and icons for a custom connector are set by its developer through the Graph schema call in row 2.' with 'Property descriptions and semantic label mappings, including the iconUrl label, are set by the developer through the Graph schema call in row 2.' Keep the connection-level icon question open; do not claim that schema PATCH sets a connector icon.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center provides schema recommendations for published custom connectors.
claims.quote: To help you get started, the Microsoft 365 admin center provides schema recommendations for published custom connectors.

claims.claim: Schema recommendations flag a missing title semantic label.
claims.quote: title – Semantically indexes the primary display name of an item. Required for meaningful result rendering and relevant Copilot results.

claims.claim: Schema recommendations flag a missing url semantic label.
claims.quote: url – Identifies the canonical link to the source item. Required for Copilot citations to link back to the source system.

claims.claim: Schema recommendations flag a missing lastModifiedBy semantic label.
claims.quote: lastModifiedBy – Identifies who last updated an item. Improves attribution in Copilot responses.

claims.claim: Schema recommendations flag a missing lastModifiedDateTime semantic label.
claims.quote: lastModifiedDateTime – Indicates when an item was last updated. Enables Copilot to reason over recency and answer time-based questions.

claims.claim: The Your Connections tab shows connection state.
claims.quote: You can view the connection state for your deployed connectors on the Your Connections tab in the admin center.

claims.claim: The connection monitoring view shows last sync time.
claims.quote: Last sync time indicates when the last successful crawl happened. The connection is as fresh as the last sync time.

claims.claim: No new actions are documented for these metadata configuration options.
claims.quote: Searched: custom connectors visibility actions; custom Copilot connectors Graph API enhancements icons visibility metadata default enabled admin switch rollout. Read roadmap, May 19 release note, schema/property resources and API overview; no new autonomous action mechanism for these options.

claims.claim: This item does not change the connector's existing access permissions.
claims.quote: Searched: custom Copilot connectors Graph API enhancements icons visibility metadata default enabled admin switch rollout; custom connectors visibility actions. Read roadmap, release note, schema guide and manage-access-permissions; no explicit unchanged-permissions guarantee for this item.
claims.fix: Replace the risk rationale with 'Low. The roadmap describes display and relevance metadata for custom connectors, not new data sources or actions; review existing connector access permissions before builders tune relevance.' This retains the documented scope and the wiki's advice without asserting an undocumented guarantee.
